scope: Applicable original base/core rules and errata only. Excluded adversaries, scenarios, expansions, later products and optional modes remain excluded despite examples or links in these broad FAQ pages.
setup_erratum_verified: One additional Blight is added to the initial Blight pool regardless of player count, with or without a Healthy Island card; this setup addition is not repeated when a card flips. Verify exact source wording and scope in the saved Setup page.
text_derivative_method: BeautifulSoup removes scripts/styles, preserves visible text, inserts image alt/title and source placeholders, and retains link targets. Raw HTML remains primary.
limitations: Text extraction can separate inline words and symbols or omit meaningful image content; inspect original HTML and relevant original source diagrams/images when necessary.
Current Living FAQ snapshot applies published base errata across printings; do not import excluded expansion-specific procedures into original base scope.
